summary: DEFSEC Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a registered direct offering of 673,006 common shares at CAD$3.74 (US$2.63) per share for gross proceeds of ~CAD$2.5 million, along with a concurrent private placement of unregistered warrants exercisable at CAD$4.39 per share. H.C. Wainwright & Co. serves as exclusive placement agent. The offering is expected to close on June 26, 2026. Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under an existing shelf registration statement, not a special situation event. No special-situation attributes such as activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or restructuring are present.
